entities.summary: Viktor Ivanov was a Ukrainian boxer. He competed for the Soviet Union in the men's heavyweight event at the 1976 Summer Olympics. At the 1976 Summer Olympics, he defeated Jürgen Fanghänel of East Germany, before losing to Atanas Sapundzhiev of Bulgaria.
